items.text: YOU ARE IN AN EMPTY ROOM. THE ONLY FEATURE IS A TRAP DOOR IN THE CENTER. DO YOU OPEN IT?

items.text: YOU ARE IN A ROOM FILLED WITH BROKEN STATUES. A HEAD BROKEN LOOSE FROM THE TORSO SHOWS A FACE FILLED WITH TERROR.

items.text: 'HEY LOOK, COULD YOU KEEP QUIET? I JUST GOT BACK FROM THE NORTH AND I'M TIRED. OKAY?' A MOMENT LATER A VOICE FROM CALLS FROM THE OTHER DOORWAY, 'MESSENGER!'

items.text: THE MAN GETS UP WITH A SIGH AND GOES INTO THE OFFICE. A MINUTE LATER HE COMES OUT PUTTING PAPERS INTO A POUCH AND GOES OUT THE DOOR. THE VOICE CALLS, 'MESSENGER!'

items.text: 'TELL AL-HYAM DHAZID TO EXECUTE PHASE 2 OF PLAN A. DISMISSED.'
